svg.title: AI video generation pipeline v2 workflow
svg.desc: A five-row workflow from intake and rights review through reference analysis, creative planning, clip generation, multilingual post-production, four human approval gates, private upload verification, and public release. Rejection arrows return to the nearest owning stage. A control plane enforces policy, budgets, artifact lineage, state transitions, and audit records.
svg.text: Local-first production with artifact lineage, bounded agents, and four human gates

g.text: Hash, inspect, and retain by policy

svg.text: Retry within quality and cost limits

g.text: for exact local and remote IDs
Provider eligibility and hard cost limit
No generator can approve its own work
Approval applies to hashes, not filenames.

svg.text: Solid arrows: forward progress | Dashed red arrows: reject or repair
